The plate is square-ish and about 26 cm across, which spans roughly 350 px in the image, so the scale is about 0.074 cm per px.

The apple is about 128 px wide, which works out to roughly 9.5 cm. That is a bit large, though the plate may be closer to 24 cm. An apple of about 8 cm diameter would weigh around 180 g. At 9 cm it would weigh around 220 g.

I'll take the apple at about 200 g. Apples run about 52 kcal per 100 g, so that gives roughly 104 kcal. A few small orange bits are left on the plate, which are negligible.
